entities.text: C.B.I. v. Aryan Singh, 2023 SCC Online SC 379
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It does not require the prosecution/investigating agency to prove the allegations.

While exercising the powers under Section 482 of the CrPC the Court has very limited jurisdiction and is required to consider "whether any sufficient material available to proceed further against the accused for which the accused is required to be tried or not".
The correctness of the allegations can only be gone into by the learned trial court after leading evidence by the parties in support of their respective cases.

5. Accordingly, the instant application is disposed of by providing that the applicants may appear before the learned trial court and submit personal bonds along with an application under Section 88 Cr.P.C. within one week from today.
In case any such application is filed, the learned trial court shall pass suitable orders in accordance with law.
The applicants shall be at liberty to raise all their please before learned trial court.
